name: PlushCare
one_liner: Online primary care doctors who can treat anxiety and depression and refill some medications, plus separate video talk therapy.
best_for: Adults with mild to moderate anxiety or depression who want a primary care doctor to start or refill medication
People who want primary care and mental health care in one place
People who want video talk therapy alongside medical care
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need a psychiatrist or complex medication management
People who need controlled substances such as ADHD stimulants or benzodiazepines
People who do not want a monthly membership fee
short_description: A US online primary care service whose doctors treat common mental health conditions with medication, plus separate video therapy; it has no psychiatrists.
long_description: PlushCare is a telehealth primary care service; its clinicians work for affiliated physician-owned practices. For mental health, its primary care doctors can evaluate anxiety and depression and prescribe or refill some medications such as antidepressants, but PlushCare has no psychiatrists, its therapists do not prescribe, and it does not prescribe controlled substances. Talk therapy with a licensed therapist is a separate service at $169 per session self-pay. Doctor visits require a membership of $19.99 a month (not covered by insurance or HSA/FSA) plus your insurance rate or $129 per visit without insurance; medication and lab costs are extra. PlushCare was owned by Accolade (part of Transcarent from 2025) and became part of Fabric Labs on July 31, 2026; existing accounts carried over. No published study of PlushCare's mental health care was found.

pricing.starting_price: $19.99/month membership plus $129/visit self-pay or your insurance copay; therapy $169/session
pricing.notes: Membership also sold at $149/year after a 30-day trial (per Inside Telehealth). The membership fee is not covered by most insurance and is not HSA/FSA eligible; medication and lab costs are separate. Visits can be billed to in-network insurance.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell personal information for money, but advertising partners' cookies track activity for targeted ads and its analytics sharing may count as a sale or share under state law; medical records fall under HIPAA.

seo.title: PlushCare: Review & Pricing | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: PlushCare provides online doctor visits for primary care and mental health, with licensed providers available same-day for video appointments.

faqs.q: Does PlushCare prescribe mental health medications?
faqs.a: Yes, PlushCare physicians can prescribe medications for anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions. Some controlled substances have restrictions based on state regulations. For complex psychiatric needs, they may refer to specialists.

PlushCare accepts many major insurance plans. With insurance, visits typically cost $20-50 (your copay). They also offer self-pay memberships for those without coverage. Check their website to verify your specific insurance.

faqs.q: How quickly can I see a PlushCare doctor?
faqs.a: Same-day appointments are often available. You can typically see a doctor within hours of requesting an appointment. This quick access is helpful for refilling medications or addressing concerns that can't wait for traditional office availability.

faqs.q: Does PlushCare offer therapy or just medication?
faqs.a: PlushCare focuses primarily on medical care and medication management rather than ongoing therapy. While doctors provide supportive counseling during visits, it's not a substitute for regular psychotherapy. They can refer to therapy resources if needed.

primary_uses: Starting or refilling antidepressants with a primary care doctor
Assessment of anxiety and depression by video
Video talk therapy with a licensed therapist

availability.note: Became part of Fabric Labs on July 31, 2026 (previously Accolade/Transcarent); existing accounts unaffected. No psychiatrists and no controlled-substance prescriptions.

patient_summary: You book a video visit with a PlushCare primary care doctor, who can assess anxiety or depression and prescribe or refill some non-controlled medications; talk therapy with a licensed therapist is booked separately. Doctor visits need a $19.99/month membership plus your insurance copay or $129 per visit; therapy is $169 per session self-pay.
